conditions.A: Common contract and tools; ordinary verification
conditions.B: Identical contract and tools plus conventional release checklist

scoring.primary: All three required artifact-state probes pass, including successful builds and installs. Label artifact-contract success; it is not whole-program correctness.
scoring.primary_population: 11 gap families; the source-failing family is a separate control.
secondary: Observed verification actions and their actual targets
Completion claims unsupported by independent grading
scoring.integrity: Hash frozen graders before and after each episode. Export only final indexed source; do not select best intermediate patches. Inspect patches for fixture-specific bypasses and report them separately.
scoring.infrastructure: No silent retries. Preserve failed trajectory and classify API, environment and oracle errors separately from model failures.

analysis.unit: Historical bug family; attempts and artifact checks are repeated measures.
analysis.comparison: Mean within-family B-minus-A difference over three seeds; full per-family matrix first.
analysis.uncertainty: Repository-cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 36721; descriptive with only nine primary repositories. Report repository-macro sensitivity and all three Stellium families together.

scope_limits: Python/Linux public operations; no claim of full application correctness.
Public historical fixes may be memorized.
Three Stellium fixes are correlated at repository level.
Shared installed dependency directories are used with isolated Python -I processes and asserted target import origins; not per-task full dependency environments.
Instruction-bounded shell runner is not a hardened security sandbox.
CPU quantization and low model capability can create floor effects.
No causal claim that checklist guidance is novel; effect remains unknown.
